description: Screenshot of an Instagram post by the account ray.chandler (associated with photographer Rachel Chandler) dated February 10, 2014. It shows a black-and-white selfie of two young blonde women, one bare-faced with a nose ring and one wearing large dark sunglasses; the caption tags @parishilton, and the sunglasses-wearing woman is consistent with Paris Hilton. The post shows 136 likes and 13 comments. The image circulated in Q-adjacent research threads about Rachel Chandler.
